Every outgoing Group edge must be an exact certified nonretaining terminal, with a nonempty left-edge cohort and no shared producer. Readiness refresh follows all consuming-storage activation. Retaining/public/custom/batch, unsupported receivers and shared producers retain original events. Summary receivers share the original Terminal apply body; checkpoint, put evaluation count, old score, guarded apply, success-only new score, checked/wrapping adjustment and replay keep their order.

Exact builtin fixed usize-ID Triple/Triple joins expose a borrowed carrier over the complete staged typed Vec after the input borrow and application guard end. FIFO publication drains into original Events without an intermediate erased Vec. Successful bounded scratch retains capacity; unwind clears/releases it. Public/custom/unbounded/partial/batch paths retain original Outputs.

Eight original native regressions cover full-range metadata/layout, stable chunks and reuse, complete staging/FIFO/fanout, abandoned carriers, real graph callbacks and canonical owners, full/current/nested captures and rollback, error/panic retries, input-lifetime independence, arena growth/shared-owner promotion, both-side join order and public/custom/borrowed fallbacks.
